capabilities.name: Repository context scan
capabilities.description: Reads the live repository structure, git state, package scripts, and Zync registry state before work begins.

capabilities.name: Relevant code search
capabilities.description: Searches source files by filename and text with repository-safe ignore rules and bounded results.

capabilities.name: Change impact review
capabilities.description: Reviews selected paths or a search query, finds references, estimates blast radius, and suggests verification jobs.

capabilities.name: Verification runner
capabilities.description: Runs only allowlisted local verification jobs and returns stdout, stderr, exit code, and duration.

capabilities.name: GitHub branch hygiene
capabilities.description: Checks remote branch heads and can refresh backup to current main after explicit admin confirmation.
